description:
FILED s537b (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-11) as #1579's acceptance measurement.  t/op/lvref.t (perl: 201 rows) transpiled into its `\state @a = [1..3]` refusal until s537b; with that fixed it stops at the NEXT refusal, still at transpile time (0 rows):

    $ ./pl2cl t/op/lvref.t
    PCL: refaliasing target not supported: (p-list-scalar (p-refgen-list (p-aslice @a__excl__3 0 1)))

THE SITES (t/op/lvref.t): 134 `\@a[0,1] = expect_list_cx;`  136 `\(@a[2,3]) = expect_list_cx;`  140 `\local @a[0,1] = (\$tmp)x2;`  172 `\@h{"a","b"} = expect_list_cx;`  174 `\(@h{2,3}) = expect_list_cx;`  178 `\local @h{"a","b"} = (\$tmp)x2;`  738/739 `local \(@a[0,1,2]) = \(@src);` / the hash twin, 748/749 the same without `local`.

MINIMAL REPRODUCER (probed vs perl 5.40.3):

    use feature 'refaliasing'; no warnings;
    my @a; my ($p, $q) = (1, 2);
    \@a[0,1] = (\$p, \$q); $p = 10; print "@a\n";        # perl: 10 2
    my %h; \@h{'x','y'} = (\$p, \$q); $q = 20; print "$h{x} $h{y}\n";   # perl: 10 20
    PCL: the transpile dies (Pl/ExprToCL.pm:1868, rule 12 -- loud).

The slice spellings were already named "loud" by #332 (the parenthesized-ARRAY spellings `\(@a) = LIST`, a SILENT wrong there).  This task is the slice half: each element slot of the slice aliased to the corresponding right-hand referent (p-setf's alias arm per element, `local` restoring the slots).

After the slices the file's NEXT whole-file refusal is `Parser2 TODO: forward goto to a standalone label` (measured by blanking the ten slice lines in a scratch copy: scratch/s537b/lvref-y.t in the s537b worktree).

REGION: Pl/ExprToCL.pm's refaliasing place lowering (`_alias_*` / the `=` lowering of a `\`-cast left side) + the runtime's alias arm.
